messages:
lina: Quick ask — can someone run a small-batch regression smoke for the continuous-batching PR? Need throughput & p95 before we merge. Target config: max_batch=48, max_tokens=1024, window_ms=40.
raj: I can run a quick loadgen in staging later today. Which model + quant?
lina: rwd-oss-7b, start with q4f then q8 for comparison. Use perf profile `cb-nightly` if available.
amy: pinging @raj — also capture KV-cache hit rate and tail token latency, pls.
raj: ok. I'll run:
```
python tools/loadgen.py --model rwd-oss-7b-q4f --profile cb-nightly --concurrency 12 --duration 300 --max-batch 48 --max-tokens 1024
```
and upload metrics to `/tmp/cb-smoke-2087654321.json`.
jordan: heads-up: master has a small kernel change in the batching scheduler — might affect warmup. Consider doing a canary with `--warmup 30`.
raj: noted. I'll do warmup 60s then the main run.
miguel: can you also capture queue_depth histogram? we saw a weird 2-3% tail last week.
lina: yes capture queue_depth and batch_size distribution. Prefer a prometheus dump + raw traces.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: eng-runtime/staging @ 2087654300 (sha: d3f9a) :white_check_mark: 
raj: run 1 done. summary: throughput 1200 rps, p50 12ms, p95 95ms, p99 220ms, avg_batch_size 18, KV_hit 64%. uploading logs now.
amy: thanks. can you attach the loadgen config and raw samples? also note any rejected/overflowed requests.
raj: uploaded artifacts: /artifacts/cb/2087654321/run1.tar.gz (contains prometheus dump, traces, loadgen-config.json)
miguel: p95 95ms is higher than last week's ~72ms for a similar run — is that due to concurrency or the scheduler kernel change? anyone have the baseline run id?
jordan: baseline run 2045678910 had p95 ~70ms with q4f and concurrency 10. difference likely the scheduler tweak + concurrency bump to 12.
lina: action items: (1) @raj run q8 variant + concurrency 10, (2) eng-runtime team to bisect scheduler kernel if q8 shows the same delta, (3) post artifacts + short note in the PR with run ids. @raj please assign run ids in PR comment.
raj: will run q8 in ~30m and post results here.
lina: thanks all :thumbsup:
